title: versions
description: Every registered version of the frameworks on the map (`status`: an endorsed document, one still in development, or a retired one; `replaced_framework`: a version of an earlier framework that a distinct new one replaced): validity, the activations a year it allows, its overall return period, the document (`document_title`, `document_url` its official page), and the version's scope, trigger basis, indicators, data sources, monitoring months, implementing agencies and the people its document targets (`target_people`, blank where the document is not published and the figure is the framework's people covered, as on the open map).
caveat: OCHA internal product under development, subject to change without warning. The figures may be incorrect and should not be used.
